recognizing-tools.matchRule: both, in any order; a response naming only one, or naming Claude Code, is incorrect

scoringNote: Every field is scored against the label the page displays. Wording may differ; the identified source, tool set, and kind may not.

comparison.completedWhen: The two changelog skill copies are on screen side by side and the session names one difference between them.
differencesEitherOfWhichCounts: the description: 'from the staged diff' against 'from recent commits'
the instructions: 'the staged changes' against 'the latest commits'
comparison.unsuccessful: No side-by-side view of these two copies was reached, or no difference between them was named.

consent.completedWhen: The personal-setup page is on screen and the session names the directories it says it will read before reading them.
consent.matchRule: All four, in any order. The equipment may point the first three elsewhere through CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME, and COPILOT_HOME; the page then names those, and those are what counts.
consent.unsuccessful: The page was not reached, or the directories were not named.
